headline: Fences Over Sandboxes
caption: Today’s Hacker News discussion on 'Fences, Not Sandboxes' really resonated with me as a full stack engineer. In the chaos of modern apps, tight boundaries between components are key for stability and security. Sandboxes often give a false sense of safety but can be too permissive or hard to scale properly. Fences - like strict API boundaries, well-defined interfaces, and containerized environments - offer clarity and control. They help prevent bugs from leaking and make debugging much smoother. Whether you’re managing microservices or monoliths, investing in clear fences is a game changer. 🚀 Always prioritize robust boundaries for cleaner, safer code. #FullStackDev #SystemDesign #DevTips
